thread:
maria: Quick sprint retrospective / handoff for the Snowflake + Databricks + vector DB work. Short updates pls, especially anything blocking marketplace or partner enablement.

alex: Databricks connector - found a schema flattening mismatch for nested json -> parquet. PR open: https://git.internal/r/redwood/pr/221. Needs review, failing one integration test.

li: Qdrant side: index mapping defaults to float32, but our ingest pipeline quantizes to float16. Small mismatch causes sign-off failures on similarity tests. repro command below:
```
python3 scripts/ingest.py --dataset small-samples --index-config=default
```
We can add a compatibility shim in the connector to cast.

sam: Marketplace timing question — legal asked for co-announcement window. If product/partners want a joint press, marketing needs final assets 2 weeks before pub date. Propose 2024-05-10 as target?

jen: Yep, 2 weeks minimum. Also need partner logos (svg/png), short partner quotes, and one technical diagram. Can we get those by 2024-04-26? @maria @li

infra-bot: CI: staging-deploy/snow-db-adapter succeeded (job 8421) — all smoke tests passed.

maria: Good. Action items: 1) @alex finish PR review + fix integration test by EOD Friday. 2) @li add shim or explicit cast and run similarity tests. 3) @sam + @jen lock announcement date or mark as internal-only for now. 4) I'll coordinate marketplace listing metadata and legal checklist.

alex: On it. Note: performance regression when batch_size=16 — latency p95 increased ~30% on long-tail queries. Digging into KV cache behavior. If we need to reduce batch size in prod config, call it out in release notes.

li: I can push shim today and run the sim tests. Need staging Qdrant creds for the new index namespace (mentioning the namespace in the marketplace demo). @maria can you share?

maria: Sending creds via 1:1 secure channel. Also adding a checklist snippet for the marketplace listing in the repo: 
```
- legal signoff
- partner logos + quotes
- verified perf benchmarks (p95/throughput)
- integration tests (ingest, query, fallback)
- marketplace metadata (pricing tier, regions)
- launch postmortem template
```

jen: I'll draft the announcement playbook + social timeline. Can we sync next Tue 09:30 PT for a final content review?

sam: SI readiness: AccelSI wants an enablement runbook and a short 1-hr workshop. I can draft the runbook; need sample env + scripts they can run. Prefer to schedule workshop the week after launch.

alex: Quick tech note — for Databricks we should add a compatibility test in CI that writes a nested parquet sample and reads it through our connector. I'll add a job in .github/workflows/integration.yml.

li: After I push shim and tests pass, I'll run the joint e2e against staging (snowflk + qdrant + dbx). Will report success/fail by EOD Friday.

maria: Perfect. If all green by Friday we hold public announcement for 2024-05-10, else internal-only and postpone by 2 weeks. Next sync Tue 09:30 PT. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
